name: allconcepts
title: HPDS allConcepts CSV (CSVLoader input)
description: Five-column, headerless CSV read by the HPDS CSVLoader (pic-sure-hpds etl/phenotype/csv/CSVLoader.java): patient_num is parsed with Integer.parseInt, nval with Double.parseDouble when non-empty, timestamp with Long.parseLong when non-empty. A row that violates these aborts the load. The split-allconcepts-by-consent job enforces the same rules in code (SplitMergedAllConceptsJob). The 'dialect' member is a non-standard annotation here (Table Schema itself has no dialect; in a Data Package it belongs on the resource): the file has no header row.

fields.name: concept_path
fields.description: Concept path, backslash- or mu-delimited. Mu to backslash conversion happens in the load runner, not in the split.

fields.name: nval
fields.description: Numeric value; empty for categorical rows.

fields.name: tval
fields.description: Text value; empty for numeric rows.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Epoch milliseconds (CSVLoader: new Date(Long.parseLong(..))), or empty. Values of 0 and values below 1e11 (likely epoch seconds) are reported by the split job, not rejected.
